$comment: Budgets for scripts/check-size.mjs, in KiB of gzip-compressed bytes (level 9). shellJs covers every .js file outside vendor/ (the app and its lazily loaded studios, panels and engines, plus the service worker). startupJs is what must load before the app is usable (index.html modules and their static imports). total covers everything the browser downloads (dist/) except fonts, license texts and the on-demand libraries (PDF import, KaTeX), which are not precached. 0.7.0: shellJs +50 for collaboration (app/src/collab + ui/collab, about 40 KiB, all lazy; start-up only gains the small command stubs). Next: shellJs +20 for Edit together (tree and text CRDTs, live bindings), LAN relay helpers and the QR encoder (all lazy; start-up gains only the share commands and one context-menu provider). VS Code extensions: shellJs +35 and total +30 (code, styles and catalog texts) (app/src/vscode + the manager tab, about 25 KiB, all lazy; loaded only when a VS Code extension is installed or the tab is opened). Open folders from the OS: totalGzipKiB +10 (folder-scan.js, the folder reader and German strings, about 4 KiB; the rest is headroom for the next change). Larger app icon PNGs: totalGzipKiB +10 (the tile now fills the canvas, about +5 KiB of PNG). Code studio sync and formatters: shellJs +15, total +20 (engine/web/format.js, ui/code/sync.js). Vibe UI v2: shellJs +30 and total +35 (mentions, change sets and diff drawer, Canvas panel, message toolbars, settings host, German strings and icons; about 27 KiB of JS, all inside the lazily loaded Vibe workspace and settings chunks, start-up unchanged). Collaboration UX: shellJs +20 and total +20 (inline comments, anchors, responsive window and the UI-only pop-out, about 25 KiB of JS, all lazy, start-up +0.2 KiB of command stubs). Refactoring audit 1 (docs/refactoring-audit.md): startupJs lowered 380 -> 365 (measured 357.2 KiB + 2 %, was 373.5 before the audit; the export dialog and the text-tool transforms with the HTML entity table left start-up). shellJs and total keep their budgets (headroom already under 1 %). Glass v2: shellJs +10 and total +10 (liquid refraction and sea palette modules; refraction-dom.js is lazy). Office Suite framework: shellJs +30 and total +40 (registry, launcher, suite host, Office Toolkit, records CRDT, Vibe suite tools, about 16 KiB gzip, all lazy; start-up +0.5 KiB of routing rows and menus; measured after rebasing onto the pixel crop tools: shell 1358, start-up 364, total 2253). The Spreadsheet, Presentation and Whiteboard apps bring their own increases.  Comments everywhere + chat bubbles: startupJs +5, shellJs +20, total +25 (comments host and panel, comment-context, bubbles, German strings; start-up gains the pure bubbles.js validator and command stubs). Vibe web tools: shellJs +10 and total +15 (web-access.js guard, extraction and search backends, the Web access settings panel and German strings, about 9 KiB gzip, all lazy; start-up gains only the tool definitions and web-hosts.js, 366.2 KiB measured). Presentation app: shellJs +40 and total +45 (deck model, PPTX and ODP codecs, PDF/PNG renderer, editor, presenter, commands and Vibe tools, about 39 KiB gzip of JS, all lazy; runtime-loaded office-slides.css and German strings; start-up +0.3 KiB of menu rows). Worker pool and extension watchdog: shellJs +26 and total +22 (the pool worker bundle, about 24 KiB gzip, carries its own copy of the resize/trace engines and fflate because workers cannot share the app chunks; pool, jobs and watchdog about 2 KiB, all lazy; start-up unchanged). Color management (ICC engine, PDF/X-1a/X-4, preflight, soft proof, CMYK sliders, Vibe color tools, German strings): shellJs +19 and total +18 (about 17.5 KiB gzip, all lazy, plus a little headroom; start-up +0.7 KiB of command stubs, menu rows and the paint pass-through; measured after rebasing onto web access and extension workers: shell 1480.5, start-up 368.2, total 2390.8). Whiteboard app: shellJs +43 and total +47 (office/board model, renderer, canvas UI, Excalidraw/tldraw codecs, commands, Vibe tools and German strings, about 43 KiB gzip with the chunks it shares, all lazy; start-up gains only the board menus in OFFICE_MENUS; measured after rebasing onto color management: shell 1523.6, start-up 368.9, total 2437.6).
